info.title: Sahab Attendance API
info.description: API for managing work templates, work plans, and attendance policies in the Sahab Payroll system.

get.description: The company's attendance log configuration (allowed files, levels, day offs, import mode, self-service settings).

post.description: Creates the company's attendance log configuration.

get.description: Work pattern used to pre-fill check-in, check-out and hours worked for an employee and date.

patch.description: Edits the company's attendance log configuration.

get.description: Processing state of every employee in a session for a pay group.
Processing state of one employee in a session.

patch.description: Moves one employee's state with an action: review, approve or revert_to_draft.

get.description: All daily (L3) records of a session key.
One employee's daily (L3) records for a session key.
One employee's daily record for one date.

patch.description: Corrects punches and derived values of a day in one call; the row is recalculated and the issue resolved.
Regularizes an Absent day or a day with a deduction using the record's shift.
Marks the day as a day off; hours worked move to weekend extra hours.
Marks the day as a holiday; hours worked move to holiday extra hours.
Overrides the day's entry and exit times and recalculates the row.
Overrides the day's total extra hours.
Overrides the day's deduction hours.
Removes a manual mark from the day and restores the calculated values.

post.description: Marks the given days as settled by payroll. Settled days cannot be edited.
Reverses settlement of the given days.

get.description: One row per employee-day with unresolved issues, with the flagged fields.
Issue counts per pay group, filtered by month, year and pay group.
Paged list of employees with issues, filtered by month, year and pay group.
Error log of a session. Optional filters: stage, severity, includeResolved.
Excel of the session's issues, or of one file's issues when fileId is passed.
Error log of one employee in a session.

patch.description: Marks every error of one stage in the session as resolved.

get.description: One employee's monthly summary (L4) for a session key.
All monthly summaries (L4) of a session.
Downloads the session's monthly summaries (L4) as an .xlsx file.
Legacy: payroll summaries (L5) of a session key. Current reporting stops at L4.
Legacy: one employee's payroll summary (L5). Current reporting stops at L4.
Legacy: downloads the session's payroll summaries (L5) as .xlsx. Current reporting stops at L4.
Lists sessions for a session (date range) key.
Cards for the Attendance Imports tab, filtered by month and/or year.
Returns one session with its files and state.

patch.description: Edits the session key, month or year of a session.

delete.description: Deletes the session and all its imported and processed data.

get.description: Header counts for a session (employees, issues, statuses).
Live import progress for a session. Poll while the status is Importing.
Live processing progress for a session. Poll while processing runs.
Uploaded files across sessions, filtered by month, year and pay group.
Files uploaded to one session.
Downloads the original CSV that was uploaded.
One employee's daily records and monthly summary for a session.

delete.description: Marks a file ImportCancelled. Rows already imported are not rolled back.

get.description: Employee grid for a session with tag, department, location, search, sort and paging.

post.description: Stage 1: uploads a monthly L3 CSV (CSV only, max 50 MB) for a pay group and month. Reuses the session for the same month, location and pay group.
Stage 2: parses the uploaded file(s) of the session into daily (L3) records and logs row issues.
Stage 3: builds the monthly summaries from the daily (L3) records for every employee in the session. isOverride=true re-runs from scratch.
Stage 3 for a single employee of the session.
Re-processes only employees whose daily records were edited after processing.
Regenerates one employee's monthly summary from the current daily records.

patch.description: Publishes a processed session so payroll and employees can use the numbers.

get.description: Lists break, grace period and overtime policies. Optional filters: state, type.
Returns one policy of any type.

post.description: Creates a break policy made of paid and unpaid breaks.
Creates a grace period policy (late check-in and early check-out grace, deviation limit, leave deduction).
Creates an overtime policy (overtime rule, optional buffer, rates per day type).

patch.description: Edits a break policy.
Edits a grace period policy.
Edits an overtime policy.
Soft-deletes a policy by marking it inactive. The document is kept.

get.description: Lists employees exempted from attendance tracking, with their effective period.

post.description: Adds one or more employees to the attendance exception list.

get.description: Returns one employee exception.

patch.description: Edits an employee exception, for example its effective period.
Removes an employee from the exception list.

get.summary: List holiday calendars for a year
get.description: Lists company and location holiday calendars for the year in the route (defaults to the current year).
Returns one holiday calendar with its yearly holiday list.

post.description: Creates the company default calendar (and its inherited location copies) or a location calendar.

patch.description: Edits a calendar's holidays for the year in the route.

post.description: Publishes the company default calendar for the current or next year and syncs it to inheriting locations.

patch.description: Detaches a location calendar from the company default so it stops receiving published changes.
Removes one holiday from a calendar for the year in the route.

get.description: Called by the Leave service: classifies each day from-to as Workday, Weekend, Holiday or HolidayOnWeekend for the employee.

post.description: Creates a roster board for a location with its supervisor, publishing frequency and optional areas.

get.description: Lists roster boards grouped by location. Optional filter: locationId.

patch.description: Adds employees to the board for a period. Employees already on another plan for those dates are refused.

get.description: Board members by segment (active, upcoming, past) with search, department, area and paging.

post.description: Previews adding employees: who is already on another plan or already on this board for the dates.

get.description: Returns one board with its shifts, areas and counts.

patch.description: Edits the board name, supervisor, publishing frequency and areas (add, remove, switch on or off).
Changes the start and end date of one employee's board membership.
Removes a future membership, or ends a started one, and clears the affected schedule.

post.description: Previews moving a board member to another plan, board or rotation.

patch.description: Moves a board member to another plan, board or rotation from a given date.
Soft-deletes the board and retires its shifts, assignments and scheduled days.

get.description: Lists the board's areas with the employees in each and those still without an area.

patch.description: Places employees in an area, or moves them from another area, and syncs their scheduled days.
Renames one area of the board.
Deletes one area of the board.

get.description: Planner landing page: every board with its status for the period around anchor, by frequency.
The planner grid for one board and the period containing anchor: employees by area, day cells and totals.
Downloads the grid for the period (optionally narrowed to areas) as an .xlsx file.

post.description: Assigns a shift or a day off to the selected employee-day slots. A published period reverts to needing republish.
Publishes the board's schedule for one period to staff.
Takes a published period back to Draft.
Clears the scheduled shifts of the period. Past days and leave days are left as they are.
Copies the previous period's shifts into empty future slots of this period.

get.description: The signed-in employee's recent pay periods with their processing status.
The signed-in employee's day-by-day schedule between from and to.

The plan and work template the signed-in employee is on. Send from/to (the week shown, max 31 days): the answer comes from today if it is in the window and assigned, else the next assigned day, else the latest assigned day before today; 404 only when no day of the window has an assignment. Without from/to, date (default today) is used as a single day.
Holidays that apply to the signed-in employee between from and to.
Grace, working hours, overtime rules, HR contact and status legend that apply to the signed-in employee.
Summary for a period, a from/to range or year to date. periods=N returns the last N periods. includeProvisional=true also counts imported days of unprocessed periods, up to the last imported date.

Processed attendance per day for a period, date or range. Optional status filter. includeProvisional=true adds imported days of unprocessed periods and fills dates up to today that have no data yet as NotAvailable (working days) or WeeklyOff / Holiday (from the schedule).

get.summary: Get my attendance for one day
get.description: Everything the log details drawer shows for one date: the day, overtime split and rate, notes, device source, rule applied, regularization, swipes and the banner. Includes imported, unprocessed days.

The rotation cycle of the signed-in employee: steps overlapping from/to (default: the current step onward, one full cycle), the current and next step, when the cycle repeats, and each plan's timing and policies.
Attendance summary of the manager's reportees for a period. periods=N returns the last N periods.
Per-reportee attendance figures for a period, paged.
One reportee's summary (period, range or periods=N), or a single day when date is passed.
One reportee's processed attendance per day. Optional status filter.
Reportees' schedules between from and to, paged.
The work plan each reportee is on for a date.
Excel report of the team's attendance for a period.
Excel report of the team's overtime (extra hours) for a period.

post.description: Creates a rotation (teams, pattern and the rotation work plans) in one call.

get.description: Lists rotations grouped by location. Optional filter: locationId.

post.description: Returns the rotation and its grid for an unsaved draft. Nothing is saved.

get.description: Returns one rotation with its plans, teams and pattern.

patch.description: Edits the rotation name, plans, teams, pattern type and weeks per step.

get.description: Returns which plan each team works on each day for a date range or number of cycles.

post.description: Tops up the generated schedule of every member through the horizon. Safe to call repeatedly.
Previews enrolling employees in a team: who is already on another plan for the dates.
Enrols employees in a rotation team from their start date and generates their schedule.

get.description: Enrolled employees by team and segment, with search, department, designation and paging.

patch.description: Changes one member's enrolment start and end date.

delete.description: Removes a future enrolment, or ends a started one on endDate.

post.description: Moves a member to another team of the same rotation from a given date.

get.description: Returns one employee's generated rotation days for a date range.

post.description: Previews moving a rotation member to another plan, board or rotation.

patch.description: Moves a rotation member to another plan, board or rotation from a given date.

get.description: Employees on a plan today by category (regular, rotation, default), with shares of the total. Filters: locationId, planType (regular|rotation|default), workPlanId, rotationId, departmentId.

Each plan worked today with its segments against now (completed, in progress, pending), overnight carry-over from yesterday, holidays and the stat tiles. Leave figures are null until leave data is available.

Scheduled employees per day, day type, holidays, rotation switches and new assignments. Defaults to the current scheduling week (Sunday start); from/to at most 31 days. Leave and coverage are null until leave data is available.

get.summary: Active regular work plans and rotations
get.description: Regular plans with employees today, and rotations with members per plan today, team positions, the next switch per team, switches today and holidays up to the next switch.
Employees on a location default plan today, newest first. group=this-week|earlier splits at the start of the scheduling week; omit it for the newest across both. Paged (pageSize default 5, max 100).
The next holidays from 'from' (default today) across this year and next, merged across locations. limit default 4, max 50.

Employees with a regular or rotation plan in the range, regular → default → rotation then by name, with one cell per day. Defaults to the current scheduling week; from/to at most 31 days. Filters: locationId, planType, workPlanId, rotationId, departmentId, search (name or code). Paged (pageSize default 10, max 100). Leave is null until leave data is available.
One employee's week, assigned plan (regular, default or rotation, with the ids Change assignment needs), rotation cycle and attendance policy. Defaults to the current scheduling week.
Lists work assignment headers (plan + period) for the company or a location.

post.description: Assigns employees to a regular work plan for a period. Conflicted employees are returned for attention.

get.description: Lists work assignments whose start date is in the future.
Returns one work assignment header.
Lists per-employee assignment rows (work assignment maps). Optional filters: locationId, state.
Returns the plan (regular, roster or rotation) each employee is on at a location on a date. locationId is required.

get.summary: Get work assignment detail by id
get.description: Returns one per-employee assignment row.

post.description: Previews a new assignment: which employees are free, which overlaps can be adjusted and which are blocked.

patch.description: Changes the start and end date of one employee's assignment row, re-checking conflicts.
Removes one employee's assignment row from the work plan.

post.description: Previews moving an employee from this regular plan to another plan, board or rotation.

patch.description: Moves an employee from this regular plan to another plan, board or rotation from a given date.

post.description: Creates the assignment and trims the employees' overlapping regular assignments around it.

get.description: Returns one work plan with its embedded work template and policies.

patch.description: Edits a regular work plan and propagates the change to the work assignments built from it.

get.summary: List employees of a regular work plan
get.description: Active, upcoming or past employees of a regular plan (segment, asOf, search, department, designation, paging).
Lists a location's work plans with counts of active and upcoming employees. Optional filters: state, type.

post.description: Creates a regular work plan from a work template and optional break, grace period and overtime policies.

patch.description: Soft-deletes a work plan. For a roster shift, its assignments on the board are retired as well.
Makes this plan the default work plan of its location.

post.description: Creates a roster work template and its roster work plan in one call and adds the shift to the board.

patch.description: Edits both halves of a roster shift (template and plan) and refreshes the assignments built from it.

get.description: Returns every template of the company, or one location's templates when locationId is passed. Optional filters: state, isDefault, templateType.
Tells whether location templates are behind the latest company default template (drives the sync banner).

post.summary: Apply latest company template to locations
post.description: Pushes the latest company default template changes to every linked location template. No-op if already up to date.

get.description: Checks whether a short code is free in this company. Codes are upper-case and unique per company.
Suggests free short codes derived from baseCode, used for the extra locations of a multi-location create.
Returns one work template with its time slots. Pass locationId for a location template.
Lists every saved version of the company default work template with its change log.

post.description: Creates a Fixed work template (same start and end time on working days). Without locationId it is a company template.
Creates a Flexi work template (required hours per day or per week, no fixed timings).
Creates a Split work template (two time slots per working day with a gap between them).
Creates a Roster work template (a shift used on roster boards). Roster templates keep their type for life.
Creates a Rotation work template (Fixed-shaped, 7 day rows). Only rotation plans can use it.

patch.description: Edits a Fixed template. Editing the company default saves a new version (new id); a location template is edited in place.
Edits a Flexi template. Editing the company default saves a new version (new id); a location template is edited in place.
Edits a Split template. Editing the company default saves a new version (new id); a location template is edited in place.
Edits a Roster template. The type cannot change to or from Roster.
Edits a Rotation template. The type cannot change to or from Rotation.
Moves a template to Archived. Archived templates cannot be picked for new work plans.
Brings an archived template back to Active.
Soft-deletes a template when the delete rules allow it; the work plans using the template are checked first.

Bearer.description: Paste your JWT access token here (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
